rationale: Adds a fixed-step suffix-loss curriculum on top of the 1.5111 reverse-tail baseline. I prepared the full modified script at /tmp/train_gpt_mlx_candidate.py, verified it is 1464 lines, and syntax-checked it with py_compile using a writable pycache. The script keeps VAL_LOSS_EVERY=0 and the final int8+zlib scorer unchanged.
title: Step-Budgeted Tail Loss Mask
